title: Invoice batches leave through a nightly export
body:
# Invoice batches leave through a nightly export

## Context
Finance needs every issued invoice delivered to the ledger vendor, and the vendor accepts files, not calls.

## Decision
A nightly job writes the day's invoices to one export file and uploads it. Rows the vendor rejects are retried up to 5 times before the job gives up on them.

## Consequences
The ledger lags by up to a day. A rejected row that exhausts its retries needs manual review.
